origins.arcanaorigins.emberborn.name: Emberborn
origins.arcanaorigins.emberborn.descript: Fire answers you. Hurl fireballs, set an ember sprite on your foes and wheel flame around you; fire and lava can't touch you, but water and rain burn.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_fireball.d: Hurl a fireball that bursts where it lands, burning everything around it. Melts frozen foes and vaporizes wet ones. 1.5-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_ember_spri: Set a little fire spirit where you look: for 8 seconds it spits fire bolts at your foes, then pops. 20-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_pyronado.d: Three wheels of flame circle you for 8 seconds, burning and shoving whatever they sweep. 60-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_fire_immun: Fire and lava can't hurt you.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_scorch.des: Your hits on burning foes are a quarter harder.
death.attack.arcanaorigins.fire_spell.pl: %1$s was burned to ash while fighting %2$s
death.attack.arcanaorigins.fire_spell.it: %1$s was burned to ash by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.arcanaorigins.wind_spell.pl: %1$s was cut down by the wind while fighting %2$s
death.attack.arcanaorigins.wind_spell.it: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's winds using %3$s
death.attack.arcanaorigins.earth_spell.p: %1$s was crushed by the earth while fighting %2$s
death.attack.arcanaorigins.crystal_spell: %1$s was shattered by crystal while fighting %2$s
death.attack.arcanaorigins.lightning_spe: %1$s was struck down by lightning while fighting %2$s
%1$s was struck down by %2$s's lightning using %3$s
death.attack.arcanaorigins.radiance_spel: %1$s was seared by light while fighting %2$s
origins.arcanaorigins.tideborn.name: Tideborn
origins.arcanaorigins.tideborn.descripti: The water answers you. Spray a shoving stream, trap foes in bubbles and send a wave to sweep them away; you breathe underwater, swim fast and heal in the rain, but heat and dry land slow you.
power.arcanaorigins.tideborn_hydro_jet.d: Spray a stream of water for a second and a half, following your aim: it soaks, shoves and splashes, and puts out fires. 3-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.tideborn_bubble_pris: Trap the creature you look at in a floating bubble for 4 seconds, helpless and wet; any hit pops it for extra damage. 15-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.tideborn_tsunami.des: Raise a wall of water that rolls 16 blocks ahead, sweeping up what it meets. 60-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.tideborn_dry_heat.de: Deserts, badlands and savannas slow you.
origins.arcanaorigins.rimeborn.name: Rimeborn
origins.arcanaorigins.rimeborn.descripti: The cold answers you. Throw piercing icicles, raise a shield of ice and freeze everything around you solid; frost can't touch you and water freezes under your feet, but fire and heat are your bane.
power.arcanaorigins.rimeborn_icicle.name: Icicle
power.arcanaorigins.rimeborn_icicle.desc: Throw an icicle that pierces one foe, frosts and slows what it hits, freezes wet foes solid and freezes water where it lands. 1-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.rimeborn_frost_shiel: A shell of ice shards absorbs 10 damage for 10 seconds and chills those who strike you; raised just before a hit, it blocks it outright. 20-second cooldown.
Flash-freeze everything within 6 blocks solid, and the water around you. 45-second cooldown.
Water freezes under your feet as you walk (not while sneaking).
power.arcanaorigins.rimeborn_fire_weakne: Fire and lava hurt you half again as much.
power.arcanaorigins.rimeborn_heat.name: Wilting
power.arcanaorigins.rimeborn_heat.descri: Deserts, badlands, savannas and jungles slow you.
message.arcanaorigins.tsunami.no_room: No room for a wave to rise here
origins.arcanaorigins.galeborn.name: Galeborn
origins.arcanaorigins.galeborn.descripti: The wind answers you. Slash with blades of air, dash untouchable through the fray and set a tornado whirling; you jump again in mid-air and never take fall damage, but you're frail and easily thrown.
Slash a crescent of wind that cuts through one foe into a second, knocking back what it cuts and spreading its element to those nearby. 1-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.galeborn_gale_dash.d: A burst of wind carries you the way you look (any way in mid-air), shoving foes aside; nothing can hurt you while it lasts, and a tailwind speeds you on. 4-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.galeborn_stormeye.de: Set a tornado down where you look: for 5 seconds it drags in, lifts and batters everything within 7 blocks, taking on the element of what it holds. 60-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.galeborn_double_jump: Press jump in mid-air to leap again.
power.arcanaorigins.galeborn_frail.name: Frail
power.arcanaorigins.galeborn_featherweig: Hits knock you back half again as far.
origins.arcanaorigins.stoneborn.name: Stoneborn
origins.arcanaorigins.stoneborn.descript: The earth answers you. Hurl boulders, wrap yourself in stone and send the ground quaking; your skin is armour, you stand firm and cut stone fast, but you sink like a rock and move a little slower.
power.arcanaorigins.stoneborn_boulder.de: Hurl a boulder in an arc: it bounces once and crushes what it lands on, shoving everything nearby away and staggering the one it hit. 2-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.stoneborn_stone_skin: Stones orbit you for 10 seconds: they absorb 8 damage, add armour, stop all knockback and hurt melee attackers. Raised just before a hit, it blocks it outright. 25-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.stoneborn_tremor.des: Three shockwaves fan out along the ground ahead, 14 blocks each, throwing up, rooting and slowing everything they reach. 45-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.stoneborn_natural_ar: Your skin is as good as armour.
power.arcanaorigins.stoneborn_stonecutte: You break stone half again as fast.
power.arcanaorigins.stoneborn_sinks.name: Like a Rock
power.arcanaorigins.stoneborn_sinks.desc: You can't swim: in water, you sink.
power.arcanaorigins.stoneborn_heavy.name: Heavy
message.arcanaorigins.stormeye.no_ground: No ground there for a tornado
message.arcanaorigins.tremor.no_ground: No ground under you for a tremor
origins.arcanaorigins.prismborn.name: Prismborn
origins.arcanaorigins.prismborn.descript: Crystal answers you. Fire bolts that burst into shards, turn projectiles back with a ward of facets and grow a sentinel that draws your foes; you sense ores through the rock and mine fast, but explosions shatter you.
power.arcanaorigins.prismborn_prism_bolt: Fire a bolt of crystal that passes through one foe and bursts into five shards on whatever it strikes. 1.5-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.prismborn_prism_ward: Crystal facets circle you for 6 seconds, turning every arrow, fireball and spell back at whoever shot it. 20-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.prismborn_geode_sent: Grow a crystal sentinel where you look: for 12 seconds every foe within 10 blocks turns on it, and it hurts back what strikes it; then it bursts. 60-second cooldown.
Every few seconds the ores within 8 blocks glow through the rock, each in its own colour.
power.arcanaorigins.prismborn_crystal_ha: You break blocks a quarter faster.
power.arcanaorigins.prismborn_brittle.de: Explosions hurt you half again as much.
origins.arcanaorigins.stormborn.name: Stormborn
origins.arcanaorigins.stormborn.descript: The storm answers you. Chain lightning from foe to foe, clap thunder around you and call a storm cloud down; lightning can't touch you and thunderstorms speed you, but water shocks you.
power.arcanaorigins.stormborn_chain_ligh: Lightning leaps from your hand to the creature you look at, then on from foe to foe; soaked foes conduct it, struck harder and passing it further. 2-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.stormborn_thundercla: A clap of thunder hurts, stuns and throws back everything within 5 blocks. 12-second cooldown.
A storm cloud follows you for 10 seconds, soaking what's under it and striking your foes nearby with lightning. 75-second cooldown.
origins.arcanaorigins.dawnborn.name: Dawnborn
origins.arcanaorigins.dawnborn.descripti: The light answers you. Call pillars of light down on your foes, raise a healing circle and a small sun; sunlight mends you and the undead burn near you, but darkness weakens you.
power.arcanaorigins.dawnborn_smite.name: Smite
power.arcanaorigins.dawnborn_smite.descr: Mark the ground where you look: a moment later a pillar of light strikes it, hurting everything around (the undead most), setting the undead alight and leaving holy ground. 2-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.dawnborn_sanctuary.d: A circle of light at your feet for 8 seconds: each second it mends you and your allies inside and sears the undead. 30-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.dawnborn_dawnbreak.d: A small sun rises over you and shines for 12 seconds, burning the undead, scorching and revealing every other foe. 90-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.dawnborn_sunlit.name: Sunlit
power.arcanaorigins.dawnborn_undead_bane: The undead catch fire near you.
power.arcanaorigins.dawnborn_dusk.name: Dusk
message.arcanaorigins.chain_lightning.no: No creature under your crosshair to strike
